credits.title: Dasher
credits.overview: Dasher is a 2026 Disney Jr. holiday special that tells the origin story of Santa's reindeer, focusing on a brave little doe named Dasher who escapes a traveling circus, helps Santa's sleigh, and eventually joins his team of reindeer.

credits.title: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
credits.overview: Eager to get off Santa's naughty list, Snoopy goes all out to be the nicest beagle in town.

credits.title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
credits.overview: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.
